messages.text: The cottages round the square were built before anyone thought about insulation. A retrofit programme would keep the warmth in.
Our roofs face the sun all afternoon. Could we put solar panels on them together?
The farms throw away a lot of green waste. A shared compost point would turn it back into soil.
The verges by the copse used to be full of wildflowers. A small meadow would bring the bees back.
